create_chinese_clip_processor: create a ChineseCLIPProcessor instance with image_processor and tokenizer for multimodal Chinese text-image processing
call_chinese_clip_processor: call the ChineseCLIPProcessor to preprocess images and Chinese text inputs into model-ready tensors
load_chinese_clip_processor: load a ChineseCLIPProcessor from a pretrained checkpoint directory using from_pretrained
save_chinese_clip_processor: save a ChineseCLIPProcessor configuration and components to a local directory with save_pretrained
build_chinese_clip_processor: build a ChineseCLIPProcessor from a HuggingFace model hub ID to process Chinese image-text pairs
